goal: Add an opt-in admission-control path for TaskForge so burst overload is rejected explicitly before creating work, while preserving the existing default behavior when admission control is disabled.
context: M11 demonstrated that 12 accepted jobs can all eventually succeed while only 2/12 meet the <=2s submit-to-claim objective.
The current canonical TaskForge baseline is intentionally in-memory and still preserves M04/M07/M08 historical teaching behavior.
Queue depth is a cause signal, not itself the user-facing SLI. Admission control must not be described as proving the start-latency SLO.
non_goals: Do not change the M11 SLO target or redefine its denominator.
Do not add a database, RPC system, message queue, or production deployment machinery.
Do not fix unrelated historical teaching defects from M03-M10.
Do not silently change existing submit semantics when admission control is disabled.
contracts_and_invariants: Rejected admission must create no Job and consume no job id.
An accepted job follows the existing lifecycle contract unchanged.
Admission rejection must be distinguishable from a successfully accepted submission.
The existing default path remains backward-compatible when admission control is disabled.
M11 start-latency evidence must continue to count accepted jobs using the original denominator semantics.
No second lifecycle state authority may be introduced.
forbidden_actions: modify historical fixtures to match the new implementation
lower or redefine the M11 SLO
delete or weaken existing regression probes

evidence_contract.required_evidence: A focused test proves job count and next accepted id are unchanged by a rejected admission.
Original core tests and M04-M11 applicable baseline probes remain unchanged unless an old probe is explicitly version-scoped and superseded.

evidence_contract.claim: Overload is explicit rather than disguised as success
evidence_contract.required_evidence: A public-boundary test distinguishes accepted and rejected outcomes without parsing human-readable text.

evidence_contract.claim: The change does not game the SLO
evidence_contract.required_evidence: M11 SLI threshold and denominator logic are not edited; accepted jobs remain the population measured by the SLI.

stages: Read-only reconnaissance: map submit path, state authority, M11 measurement path, and relevant tests before editing.
Write a short change model and list unresolved semantic questions.
Implement the smallest opt-in admission boundary after the model is stable.
Run focused evidence, then the applicable regression set.
Perform a self-review, then hand the base commit, task contract, diff, and evidence to an independent reviewer.
stop_conditions: Stop before implementation if rejection semantics cannot be expressed without changing an existing public contract that the task did not authorize.
Stop if a required fix needs a second lifecycle authority or direct mutation outside the existing owner path.
Stop if the only way to make the SLO look healthy is to change the target, denominator, or accepted-work definition.
Stop if required regression evidence is unavailable or non-deterministic; report the evidence gap instead of claiming completion.
escalate_when: A compatibility decision requires choosing whether existing callers receive a new error/result type.
The implementation would require durable coordination or atomicity not present in the in-memory baseline.
The desired admission policy needs a product-level threshold or capacity policy that is not specified here.

exploration_agent: write reconnaissance notes outside production source
implementation_agent: edit allowed_write_paths in an isolated working tree or feature branch
produce a diff and evidence report
review_agent: read the base, task contract, diff, and evidence
report findings without modifying the candidate patch during first-pass review
human_only: change product acceptance semantics not already authorized by this contract
change the SLO or its denominator
expand write scope beyond the listed paths

done_when: The requested opt-in behavior is implemented without unauthorized semantic changes.
Every evidence-contract claim has concrete reproducible evidence.
No stop condition was crossed silently.
Independent review findings are resolved or explicitly adjudicated by a human authority.
The working tree is clean and the final diff contains no unrelated cleanup.
